answer: Audits are logged in trellis, queued in anchor, and reef publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 29 identities per epoch. A farm of 161 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3359 identities would post 2400 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
